chapter: Carnegie Hall, nicknames and later career
title: Marijuana in Kansas City and the Pendergast machine
summary: Kuehl asks whether marijuana was legal in Kansas City before 1937; Basie says people were getting busted and knows nothing about the political machine.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
